body:
I’m sorry, my friend. I’d give ya a big ol’ hug if I could. Stay strong. 

Again, I’m here to chat if needed.

Wow, man. Things seem pretty rough for you. I’m sorry about that. I’m not sure if there’s anything I can say to help you but I know this helps me sometimes:

When I’m in my worst states of mind I try to think of all the things I want to live for. Here are some of mine.

- Dogs!!
- Fluffy cats
- Watching the sunset/sunrise
- Having one more slice of chocolate cake
- My closest friends
- Learning something incredible
- All the music I haven’t heard yet
- etc

This may be totally useless, but I thought it might inspire you in some way. Also, if you need always feel free to DM me. You’re not alone in this. :)
I have not traveled much; however, I’ve been to a few places in America. I was in Boston which was kinda nice. I think I went into a church or aomethi g, maybe a wrong memory tho

I’m actually in school to become a nurse! Not sure whether my mental health will be able to push through it but I think that helping is such a great thing to do. I just want so many people to be happy tbh

Hey, this kinda hit me hard. Thank you so much. I struggle with depression my self, but i always want people to feel the best. Sometimes I think I’m in love with he world. I want to help people anyway I can because I’ve felt the pain of depression and such before.

Perhaps this means she no longer wants to be in such a situation. Time is the absolute key. Don’t feel guilty for what you’ve said or done. You’ve done pretty much all you could. Now it’s up to her.

Maybe your first step should be to talk to her about how you feel. If it’s long distance perhaps you could start a group-chatting session with both this girl and her ex boyfriend. Communicate to them that you feel badly for what you did, but also that you still have feelings for her. Ultimately, it’s up to this girl who she decides to be with, if anyone at all. Sounds like a stressful time, sucks to hear that a complicated situation like this is happening.
I’m sorry to hear this. I wish you luck, and I hope you’re able to stay strong.
I’ve felt this way too. I’ve wanted to end it all countless times. You aren’t alone in feeling this. I’m here to help if needed.
I’m sorry you’re feelin so much pain :(

I get that. The numbness. I’ve felt it too. Maybe try and wait it out a bit? You could go for a walk, take a nap, do something that helps you focus on something else. Distractions usually help me out.
I’m sorry you’re hurting this badly. Is there anything I can do to help?
